info.name: RxConnect Pharmacy API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the RxConnect Pharmacy backend. Base URL: http://localhost:5000

Authentication: Use the 'Login' request first, then copy the token into the collection variable {{token}}.

Roles:
- customer  → access /customer, /placeorder, /prescriptions
- pharmacist → access /pharmacist
- admin      → access /admin

item.name: 🔐 Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints — register, login, and profile.

request.description:
POST /auth/register
Creates a new customer account. No role_secret required for 'customer'.

Response 201: { success, message, data: { token, user } }
Response 409: Email already registered
Response 400: Invalid role

POST /auth/register
Creates an admin account. Requires role_secret matching ADMIN_SECRET in .env.

Response 201: { success, message, data: { token, user } }
Response 403: Invalid admin registration secret

POST /auth/register
Creates a pharmacist account. Requires role_secret matching PHARMACIST_SECRET in .env.

Response 201: { success, message, data: { token, user } }
Response 403: Invalid pharmacist registration secret

POST /auth/login
Authenticates a user and returns a JWT.
The test script auto-saves the token to {{token}} collection variable.

Response 200: { success, message, data: { token, user } }
Response 401: Invalid email or password

GET /auth/profile  [Auth Required]
Returns the logged-in user's profile. Requires valid Bearer token.

Response 200: { success, data: { user: { id, name, email, role, phone, address, branch_id, created_at } } }
Response 401: No token / invalid token
Response 404: User not found

item.name: 💊 Medicines
item.description: Public endpoint to browse all available medicines.

item.name: 🛒 Orders — Check Stock
item.description: Check medicine stock availability across all branches.

request.description:
POST /orders/check-stock  [Public]
Checks which branches have all requested medicines in stock.

Request Body:
  medicines: [ { medicineId: number, quantity: number } ]

Response 200: {
  success,
  prescriptionRequired: boolean,
  prescriptionMedicines: [ { id, name, is_prescription_required } ],
  availableBranches: [ { branchId, branchName, availableMedicines: [...] } ]
}
Response 400: Medicine list required
Response 404: One or more medicines not found

POST /placeorder/place  [Auth Required — customer]
Places a new order at a specific branch.

Request Body:
  branchId: number  (required)
  requiresPrescription: boolean
  items: [ { medicine_id: number, quantity: number } ]

Response 201: { success, orderId, message, nextStep: 'Upload Prescription' | 'Order Confirmed' }
Response 400: Missing branchId or items / Invalid medicine ID / DB function error
Response 404: Branch not found
Response 401: Unauthorized (no/invalid token)
Response 403: Wrong role

Same as Place Order but with requiresPrescription: true.
After success, use the returned orderId to upload a prescription.

item.name: 👤 Customer
item.description: Customer-facing order history endpoints (auth required, role: customer).

request.description:
GET /customer/orders  [Auth Required — customer]
Returns all orders placed by the logged-in customer.

Response 200: { success, orders: [ { order_id, status, requires_prescription, stock_reserved, created_at, branch_name, branch_location } ] }
Response 401: Unauthorized
Response 403: Wrong role

GET /customer/orders/:id  [Auth Required — customer]
Returns full details for a specific order owned by the logged-in customer.

Path Param: id — numeric order ID

Response 200: {
  success,
  order: { order_id, status, requires_prescription, stock_reserved, created_at, branch_id, branch_name, branch_location },
  items: [ { item_id, medicine_id, medicine_name, is_prescription_required, quantity } ],
  prescription: { id, image_url, uploaded_at, verification_status, verified_at, rejection_reason } | null
}
Response 400: Invalid Order ID
Response 404: Order not found
Response 401: Unauthorized
Response 403: Wrong role

formdata.description: The numeric order ID that requires a prescription
Image file: jpeg, jpg, png, webp, or gif. Max size: 5 MB

request.description:
POST /prescriptions/upload  [Auth Required — customer]
Uploads a prescription image for an order that requires it.
Content-Type is auto-set to multipart/form-data by Postman when using form-data body.

Form Fields:
  orderId     (text)  — required, numeric
  prescription (file) — required, image file (jpg/png/webp/gif, max 5MB)

Response 201: {
  success,
  message: 'Prescription uploaded. Awaiting pharmacist review.',
  data: { prescription: { id, order_id, image_url, uploaded_at, verification_status } }
}
Response 400: Invalid/missing orderId, no file, order doesn't require prescription
Response 403: Not your order
Response 404: Order not found
Response 409: Prescription already uploaded for this order
Response 401: Unauthorized

item.name: 💼 Pharmacist
item.description: Pharmacist prescription review endpoints (currently no auth guard applied in routes).

request.description:
POST /pharmacist/approve  [No auth guard currently]
Approves a pending prescription and updates the linked order status to 'Verified'.

Request Body:
  prescriptionId: number (required)

Response 200: { success, message: 'Prescription Approved' }
Response 400: Missing prescriptionId / Already processed
Response 404: Prescription not found

POST /pharmacist/reject  [No auth guard currently]
Rejects a pending prescription, updates order status, and releases reserved stock.

Request Body:
  prescriptionId: number (required)
  rejectionReason: string (optional, defaults to 'No reason')

Response 200: { success, message: 'Prescription Rejected', stockRelease: string }
Response 400: Missing prescriptionId / Already processed
Response 404: Prescription not found

item.name: 🛡️ Admin
item.description: Admin-only endpoints — require a valid JWT with role=admin.

request.description:
GET /admin/users  [Auth Required — admin]
Returns all registered users ordered by creation date (newest first).

Response 200: { success, users: [ { id, name, email, role, phone, address, branch_id, created_at } ] }
Response 401: Unauthorized
Response 403: Wrong role

GET /admin/orders  [Auth Required — admin]
Returns all orders system-wide (newest first), joined with branch, customer, and prescription data.

Response 200: {
  success,
  orders: [ { order_id, status, requires_prescription, stock_reserved, created_at, branch_name, customer_name, verification_status, image_url, rejection_reason } ]
}
Response 401: Unauthorized
Response 403: Wrong role

GET /
Simple server liveness check.

Response 200: 'Server is running'
